description: Submit a charter flight booking request to SkyAccess. This sends the traveler's name, email and trip details (route, date, passengers and any notes) to SkyAccess so a specialist can follow up. A SkyAccess specialist will follow up with the requester by email shortly to confirm availability and pricing. No payment is taken and no booking is created: this only starts the enquiry. Privacy policy: https://skyaccess.com/privacy

departureDate.description: Departure date in ISO format (required), e.g. "2026-08-15"

destination.description: Arrival city or airport (required), e.g. "Miami" or "KMIA"

email.description: Email address of the requester (required). A specialist will reply here.

notes.description: Optional notes or special requests (e.g. catering, pet, preferred aircraft)

origin.description: Departure city or airport (required), e.g. "Los Angeles" or "LAX"

name: request_booking
title: Request a charter booking
